title: Monozari's Better Potatoes
body:
(Minecraft Title Generator Blockbench Plugin By Ewan Howell)

The best potatoes ever. 

Now now, before you get mad, I know I have referred to my potatoes as the best ever made, and I can see how any fellow potato resource pack makers could see this as a personal attack, and I can see why.

However, I do want you to know that this is not my intent. This way of presentation is purely for comedic purposes. I don't actually enjoy eating raw potatoes, none of us probably do. But I really don't think I could make a resource pack this good without eating raw potatoes to get the best inspiration.

Though, even still, I do genuinely think that my resource pack is the best out there. I am very proud of the work I have created here, and would not release my potatoes if I didn't think it was PEAK. Though that said, I have only really set the bar so high as I personally say "the best" is, as "the best" here is literally just decided by myself.

As a potato resource pack developer myself I deeply respect our potato friends that grow in the soil just as much as the rest of us potato resource pack developers. So please, take this declaration of my superiority not as an insult, but as an invitation to make something better.

(This is all for comedic purposes. This is nothing but jokes. There is an actual resource pack, though.)
